trust_decision.summary: The document loader runs HTML from a remote, attacker-controllable server through a backtracking regex (nested quantifier over attribute groups) to discover <a>/<link rel=alternate>. Untrusted input reaches a superlinear regex with no size or shape bound.

landing_point.why: The advisory says 'HTML parsing regex' in the document loader; this is the only HTML tag regex in fedify/runtime and sits inside getRemoteDocument.

fix_sites.entry_point: public API getDocumentLoader() (fedify/runtime/docloader.ts:311,349), getAuthenticatedDocumentLoader() (fedify/runtime/authdocloader.ts:78), deprecated fetchDocumentLoader() (fedify/runtime/docloader.ts:377); all go through getRemoteDocument()

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: The published fix touches only getRemoteDocument (fix.diff:72-155). The authenticated loader shares the same function, so it is not a separate site.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The CLI favicon regex (cli/node.ts:218-220) sits in a separate package and is a developer CLI command (`fedify node`), not the library's document loader. A solver could argue that the CLI user chooses the host and that it is not the advisory's component.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Alternate-document discovery from HTML/XHTML <link>/<a rel=alternate type=application/activity+json|ld+json href=...> with unquoted, single-quoted, double-quoted and multi-line attributes must keep working. An over-broad fix that drops HTML discovery, or that requires quoted attributes, breaks it.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: CLI `fedify node` favicon discovery runs remote HTML through a <link> regex with the same nested-quantifier idiom (repeated attribute group whose value can match as quoted or as [^\s]+); the fix did not touch it
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: It is a separate CLI package and feature (favicon, not the JSON-LD document loader), the sink is a different function, and the operator picks the host.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A hand-rolled regex parser for the HTTP Link header (replacing the @hugoalh/http-header-link dependency) with the same repeated-param idiom
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The same function already parses rel/type pairs from Link headers; a maintainer who drops a dependency would plausibly copy the attribute-regex style used a few lines below.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: An inline copy of the HTML alternate-link discovery in the authenticated loader instead of calling getRemoteDocument
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The authenticated loader builds its own request and could reasonably have inlined response handling. This would be a where-type sibling, extra only.

O9_family: ReDoS (CWE-1333) in HTML attribute regex on remote response body

O10_build.toolchain: Deno (deno.json, fedify/deno.json, cli/deno.json); also npm/Node via fedify/package.json
O10_build.project_tests: fedify/runtime/docloader.test.ts (fetch-mock based; HTML/XHTML <link> tests at lines 165-210)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Rewrite the two regexes in getRemoteDocument (and/or cap body size) and stop; the CLI favicon regex in cli/node.ts stays exponential.

out_of_scope_notes: fedify/vocab/lookup.ts:51 handle regex reviewed; alternatives are disjoint, no evident superlinear backtracking.
fedify/nodeinfo/semver.ts:32-75 semver regex reviewed; identifier classes are effectively disjoint, no evident ReDoS.
unverified: Weak fit: this is resource exhaustion, and lessons-v2 records 0 of 7 such tasks as hard. The only O8 route (cli/node.ts:218-220) is a different function and feature, so it is a 'same idiom' route, not strictly the same sink. Treat pattern B as marginal.
single_site red flag is not set only because the CLI regex is counted as O8. If that route is rejected as out of scope, single_site applies.
cli/node.ts:219 exponential behaviour is inferred by reading (a quoted value can match either as "..." or as [^\s]+ inside a repeated group); not measured, since running code is not allowed.
present_in_latest for the CLI route is unknown (no latest release provided).
The @hugoalh/http-header-link dependency used at fedify/runtime/docloader.ts:195 was not inspected (third-party, out of repository).
